function.name: show_action_button
function.description: Show a simple clickable action button in the AI chat with optional explanatory text and a target link.

message.description: Optional short message shown above or beside the button to explain why the user should click it.

label.description: Required short button label shown to the user.

url.description: Required target link. Use an https/http URL or a Kooboo relative path that starts with '/'.
